node.label: Lacrimal duct atresia
node.definition: A developmental disorder of the lacrimal drainage system that most often affects the lacrimal ostium and resulting in non-opening of the nasolacrimal duct. It usually results from a non-canalization of the nasolacrimal duct.

diseases.label: neurodevelopmental disorder with congenital cardiac defects and variable renal and ocular abnormalities
